items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I have a daughter named Nancy Jo. Nancy Jo Wilson.

ctx.x: Which was My Foolish Heart. See, now a lot of people won’t remember that number because I was now working for a man by the name of Buck Ram. Buck Ram who was a bandleader at one time, who wrote Twilight Time, he wrote a – a popular hit number. And so Buck Ram wanted me to work for him. He had The Platters, okay. So Buck Ram wanted to be working with me, and um, this is when I had to start moving up um, financially, I had to start to try to move up. Now I had owned my first home, which I gave to my first wife, and…
